title: A Alibi for the Portrait Revisited
author: Yara Yarrow
blurb: Marguerite Okonkwo, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
